Visiting

Opening hours & best time

Pantai Carocok is an open space; the hours shown on the map are not a guarantee of today’s access, island, or water activities. This page separates the snapshot from the recommendation.

Updated · 28 Oktober 2026

Snapshot

Hours from Google Maps

Maps checked on 19 October 2026 lists Mon/Wed 07:00–19:00, Tue/Thu 07:30–19:00, Fri 08:00–19:00, Sat/Sun 07:00–19:30. This is a listing snapshot, not a guarantee of access or services.

Not a guarantee

The listing can change and does not guarantee island, boat, or water activities are available. Confirm with staff on arrival.

Comfortable time

When to come

Morning and late afternoon give softer light and lower heat exposure. Weather still needs checking because the beach is exposed.

  • Morning: good for calm photos and avoiding heat.
  • Sunset: popular for watching the light change across the bay.
  • Avoid midday heat if with children or seniors.

Season

Time within the year

West Sumatra’s coast has rainfall patterns that affect comfort. See the weather and season page for broader detail.

Questions

Before you go

01What are Pantai Carocok’s opening hours?+

Maps checked 19 October 2026 lists Mon/Wed 07:00–19:00, Tue/Thu 07:30–19:00, Fri 08:00–19:00, Sat/Sun 07:00–19:30. This is a snapshot and not a guarantee of today’s services; confirm with staff.

02Which day is busiest?+

Weekends and holidays tend to be busier, so parking and the jetty are more crowded. Weekdays are usually calmer.

03Can I come at night?+

As an open space, night presence depends on local lighting and safety. We do not recommend swimming or boating at night.

04When does the beach close?+

Closing times on the listing vary by day. Since this is not guaranteed, ask staff about time limits during your visit.
